name: Mossback Bruin
summary: A bear so old that moss, ferns, and a small birch have taken root along its spine.
description: Woodcutters give a mossback a wide berth and a wide river besides. It sleeps through the cold months and wakes slowly, and the forest around its den stays green long after the first frost.

traits.name: Living Moss
traits.text: At the start of each of its turns, the bruin regains hit points equal to its Constitution modifier if it is in dim light or in a forest, and it has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forest terrain. It does not regain hit points if it took Fire or Radiant damage since the end of its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bruin makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition if it is Large or smaller and the bruin has moved at least 10 feet straight toward it this turn.
